Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Hebrew

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Hebrew
public class Hebrew extends Object
Hebrew-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_HEBREW section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x0c.
